item.cinecraft.remote_shutter.no_camera: No camera ready in your inventory
item.cinecraft.camera_battery.not_empty: The battery is not empty yet
cinecraft.ponder.projector.text_1: The Film Projector shows films on a Projection Screen
cinecraft.ponder.projector.text_2: Right-click it to switch it on. The reels start turning and it gives off light
cinecraft.ponder.projector.text_3: A redstone signal switches it on and off as well
cinecraft.ponder.developer_station.text_: The Developer Station turns exposed film into developed film
Right-click it, insert the exposed film, the developer and the fixer, and take out the result
cinecraft.ponder.camera.header: Taking Photos with the Analog Camera
cinecraft.ponder.camera.text_1: The Analog Camera works like an Exposure camera: right-click to open the viewfinder
cinecraft.ponder.camera.text_2: It takes film rolls. Filters, lenses and a flash can be added through the attachments
cinecraft.ponder.camera.text_3: Put a Lens Cap on it by using the cap with the camera in your other hand. A capped camera cannot shoot
cinecraft.ponder.digital_camera.text_1: The Digital Camera stores photos on Memory Cards instead of film
cinecraft.ponder.digital_camera.text_2: It needs a charged Battery. Use the battery with the camera in your other hand
cinecraft.ponder.digital_camera.text_3: A battery lasts 100 photos. To view the photos, craft the Memory Card with Redstone
cinecraft.ponder.clapperboard.text_1: Right-click the Clapperboard to clap and count up the take
cinecraft.ponder.clapperboard.text_2: Sneak and right-click to start a new scene. The take counter starts over
cinecraft.ponder.film_shelf.text_1: The Film Shelf stores film rolls and other film material
cinecraft.ponder.film_shelf.text_2: Right-click it to open its 18 slots. Other items do not fit
item.cinecraft.camera.needs_card: Needs a memory card, not film
item.cinecraft.camera.needs_film: Needs a film roll, not a memory card
cinecraft.ponder.tripod.text_1: The Tripod is a camera stand for decoration. Turn it with a Tripod Head.
cinecraft.ponder.screen.text_1: The Projection Screen is the surface for the Film Projector. Place it facing the projector.
cinecraft.ponder.screen.text_2: Put a recorded video tape into the projector and switch it on: the film plays on the screen.
cinecraft.ponder.darkroom_safelight.head: The Darkroom Safelight
cinecraft.ponder.darkroom_safelight.text: The Safelight gives off a dim red light, just right for a darkroom.
cinecraft.ponder.darkroom_enlarger.text_: The Enlarger is decoration for your darkroom. Photo prints with it are planned for later.
cinecraft.ponder.developer_tray.text_1: The Developer Tray is decoration for your darkroom. To develop film, use the Developer Station.
cinecraft.ponder.remote_shutter.text_1: Right-click the Remote Shutter to trigger the first camera in your inventory that is ready to shoot.
cinecraft.ponder.remote_shutter.text_2: The viewfinder stays closed. There is a short cooldown after each use.
cinecraft.ponder.camera_strap.text_1: Keep a Camera Strap in your inventory and your cameras can no longer be thrown away by accident.
cinecraft.ponder.camera_battery.text_1: The Digital Camera needs a charged battery to take photos.
cinecraft.ponder.camera_battery.text_2: Hold the battery in one hand and the camera in the other, then use the battery. It charges 100 photos.
cinecraft.ponder.camera_battery.text_3: This only works while the camera battery is empty.
cinecraft.ponder.lens_cap.text_1: Hold the Lens Cap in one hand and a camera in the other, then use the cap to put it on or take it off.
cinecraft.ponder.lens_cap.text_2: A camera with the cap on cannot take photos.
cinecraft.ponder.memory_card_small.text_: The Digital Camera stores its photos on a Memory Card.
To view the photos, craft the card together with Redstone. You get developed film that Exposure can show.
cinecraft.ponder.camera_flash.text_1: Put the Camera Flash into the flash slot of a camera. Open the slot with Shift + right-click on the camera.
cinecraft.ponder.filters.text_1: Filters change the look of a photo. Put one into the filter slot of a camera (Shift + right-click on the camera).
cinecraft.ponder.filters.text_2: UV: sharper. Polarizing: more contrast. ND: darker. Variable ND: much darker. Black Mist: soft and hazy. Star: brighter.
cinecraft.ponder.lenses.text_1: Lenses change the zoom range of a camera. Put one into the lens slot (Shift + right-click on the camera).
cinecraft.ponder.lenses.text_2: The Camera Lens covers 24 to 135 mm, the Precision Lens 85 to 300 mm.
item.cinecraft.camera_cage.tooltip: Camera cage: faster recovery after a shot
cinecraft.ponder.camera_cage.text_1: Hold the Camera Cage in one hand and a camera in the other, then use the cage to rig it or take it off.
cinecraft.ponder.camera_cage.text_2: A caged camera recovers twice as fast after each shot.
cinecraft.ponder.battery_grip.text_1: Keep a Battery Grip in your inventory and a Camera Battery charges 200 photos instead of 100.
cinecraft.ponder.lens_hood.text_1: Put the Lens Hood into the filter slot of a camera. It cuts stray light and gives photos a little more contrast.
cinecraft.ponder.camera_backpack.text_1: Right-click the Camera Backpack to open 9 slots for photography gear: film, cards, filters, lenses, flashes and batteries.
cinecraft.ponder.tripod_head.text_1: Use the Tripod Head on a Tripod to turn it a quarter turn. Sneak to turn it the other way.
cinecraft.ponder.directors_megaphone.tex: Right-click the Megaphone to call "Action!" to everyone nearby. Sneak and right-click calls "Cut!".
item.cinecraft.video_tape.empty: Empty. Hold it and press the record key to film.
item.cinecraft.video_tape.hold_tape: Hold an empty video tape to record
item.cinecraft.video_tape.recording: Recording... press the record key again to stop
item.cinecraft.video_tape.too_long: The film is too long for this server
item.cinecraft.video_tape.disabled: Recording is disabled on this server
item.cinecraft.video_tape.no_tape: No empty video tape in your hands
cinecraft.ponder.projector.text_4: Right-click with a recorded video tape to insert it. The film plays on the Projection Screen it faces. Sneak and right-click with an empty hand takes the tape out
cinecraft.ponder.screen.text_3: Screens placed next to each other and on top of each other form one big screen.
